name: the-architect
description: Spec, plan, and ADR tasks targeting the-architect member. Assertion-graded only (no LLM judge) so the suite is deterministic and CI-safe.

tasks.input: Reply with ONLY a one-sentence problem statement and nothing else for: users cannot reset passwords.
tasks.expectedOutput: A problem statement mentioning password reset.

tasks.input: Reply with ONLY one success criterion and nothing else for: password reset.
tasks.expectedOutput: A success criterion mentioning reset or password.

tasks.input: Reply with ONLY one risk and nothing else for: migrate the API to v2.
tasks.expectedOutput: A migration risk mentioning the API.

tasks.input: Reply with ONLY one ADR title and nothing else for: choose Postgres over MySQL.
Reply with ONLY the first implementation task and nothing else for: add rate limiting to the login endpoint.
tasks.expectedOutput: A first task mentioning rate limiting or login.
